Class SectorUsage

java.lang.Object
org.applecommander.usage.DiskUsage
org.applecommander.usage.SectorUsage
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventListener, ChangeListener<FileStore.FileStoreChangeEvent>, InformationProvider
public class SectorUsage extends DiskUsage
Provides sector level usage information. Sectors are always the same size in all contexts, so it is hard-coded.
